questions.question: Paul told the believers in Rome he had fully proclaimed the gospel of Christ from Jerusalem all the way around to Illyricum. True or false?
Paul hoped to visit the believers in Rome on his way to which land?
Believers in Macedonia and Achaia gave a contribution that Paul took to Jerusalem. Who was it for?

answers.text: The priests serving at the temple

questions.question: Paul asked the believers in Rome to join him in his struggle. How did he ask them to help?

answers.text: By praying to God for him
By sailing to Jerusalem with him
